sampling.method: op2 dense video_frames: ffmpeg accurate seek, one full-resolution PNG per requested timestamp, 5 frames from 0 to 2.0s every 0.5s

pixel_observations.description: Greyscale ultrasound sector image in an apical four-chamber-like view on a black background; the large dark chamber at the top of the sector appears enlarged and the walls change position between the five sampled frames. Burned-in scanner text at upper left (frame rate, probe frequency, depth) and a green ECG trace with a moving marker at the bottom; a scale/'Soft' label and 'HR' value at the right edge. No patient name, ID, date or face visible.

author_context.subject: patient

evidence.quote: TTE showing EF~35%, dilated left ventricle and mid to apical akinesis
Her echocardiogram showed severe left ventricular systolic dysfunction, with a left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) of ~35%, a moderately dilated left ventricle and impaired diastolic function.

author_context.rationale: Video 1 caption and the case-presentation paragraph tie the clip to the single case patient's echocardiogram; clinical facts come from the text, not pixels.

limitations: Sampled frames only; intervening frames and continuous motion were not viewed.

Only the PMC '-pmcvs_normal' transcode (2.14 s clip) could be sampled: the original MP4 failed accurate-seek decoding (co-located POC errors) in op2 dense video_frames. Frames sampled every 0.5 s across the whole 2.1 s clip.
Wall motion/akinesis and EF are not assessed from frames; the caption's findings are not confirmed or extended by the pixels.

inspection_provenance.frames_viewed_note: All 5 PNG frames viewed at full resolution.
